[SWS_CRYPT_02703]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
ara::crypto::cryp::DecryptorPriva-
teCtx::SetKey
shall check the allowed-usage flags of the key parameter provided.
If
kAllowDataDecryption
is not set, a
kUsageViolation
error shall be returned.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02202)
